summary: Registry is a mutable, name-keyed store of ProfileDescriptors and their DescriptorProfile classes. Consumer domains instantiate one Registry per domain, then use registry.register() or the @registry.decorator() pattern. Prevents duplicate registrations with clear error messages.
extension_points: _snapshot_for_tests / _reset_for_tests — test seams for registry state isolation
lifecycle_notes: Registry is not a singleton — each domain creates its own instance
register() raises ValueError on duplicate descriptor.name — prevents accidental double-registration
get_descriptor() and get_settings_class() raise KeyError with helpful 'Known: ...' hints
documentation_hooks: Usage pattern: REGISTRY = Registry('name'); register = REGISTRY.decorator(); @register(DESCRIPTOR) class MyProfile(DescriptorProfile): ...
